title_zh: 小花猫交朋友-带背景音乐
title_en: Little Flower Cat Makes Friends - With Background Music

page_text_ocr_zh: 一只小花猫闷闷不乐地趴在树枝上，这时候一只小白兔走过来了，小花猫，小花猫，我是小白兔，我来跟你一起做朋友吧。这时候小花猫生气地说：“你看看你，红眼睛，长耳朵，一看就是一个坏家伙，哼！我才不愿意跟你做朋友呢。”小白兔就伤心地离开了。
page_text_en: A little spotted cat was lying on a tree branch, looking unhappy. At that moment, a little white rabbit came over. "Little spotted cat, little spotted cat, I'm the white rabbit. I want to be your friend!" The little spotted cat got angry and said, "Look at you, red eyes, long ears, you look like a bad guy. Hmph! I don't want to be friends with you!" The little white rabbit left sadly.
summary_zh: 小花猫趴在树屋的树枝上闷闷不乐，小白兔前来想和它交朋友，但小花猫因嫌弃小白兔的外貌而拒绝，小白兔伤心地离开了。

page_text_en: At this moment, a little squirrel bounced over. "Little flower cat, little flower cat, I'm the squirrel. Let's go pick fruits in the garden together!" The little flower cat got angry and said, "Look at you, you sly fellow, you look like a bad guy. Hmph! I don't even want to be friends with you." The little squirrel left sadly.

page_text_ocr_zh: 这时候一只大灰狼跑过来了，“嗷呜。。。小花猫小花猫，你长得那么美丽，不应该像鸟儿一样站在树上，你应该像大老虎一样站在地下。快下来跟我一起做游戏吧。”这时候小花猫自言自语道，“嗯，大灰狼不停地夸我漂亮，跟他做朋友应该不错。”
page_text_en: At this moment, a big gray wolf ran over, "Awooo... Little flower cat, little flower cat, you are so beautiful. You shouldn't stand on the tree like a bird. You should stand on the ground like a big tiger. Come down and play with me!" At this moment, the little flower cat thought to himself, "Hmm, the big gray wolf keeps praising me for being beautiful. It should be fine to be friends with him."
summary_zh: 大灰狼来到树下，夸赞小花猫美丽并邀请它一起做游戏，小花猫内心觉得大灰狼的夸奖很受用，认为和它做朋友应该不错。
